descriptionChirho: A shield or buckler, a piece of defensive military equipment. The Hebrew shelet refers to a type of shield, with some English translations distinguishing 'shields' from 'bucklers' but the underlying Hebrew noun is the same word throughout. Spanish escudos/paveses ('shields/bucklers'), Arabic al-atras/al-majann/turuwsahum/shilTi ('shields' in various forms), Hindi Dhaalen/parichen ('shields'), Korean bangpaedeul ('shields'), Swahili ngao/vigao ('shields'). All clusters are grammatical variants (construct, absolute, with article, with suffix) of a single noun denoting defensive armor.
